intro: Taskify ("Taskify", "we", "us" or "our") helps you and your team plan projects, manage tasks and stay on track. This policy explains what information the Taskify mobile app and website collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have. We have kept it short and in plain language.

highlights.title: We never sell your data
highlights.description: No ads, no data brokers, no third-party trackers.

highlights.title: Biometrics stay on your phone
highlights.description: Fingerprint and Face ID are checked by your device, never sent to us.

highlights.title: Encrypted in transit
highlights.description: All traffic uses HTTPS and passwords are stored as one-way hashes.

highlights.title: Delete anytime
highlights.description: Remove your account from inside the app, no email needed.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Taskify is the provider of the Taskify mobile app and website and is responsible for your personal information under this policy.

groups.title: Legal name
items: Taskify

groups.title: Contact email
items: taskify2026@gmail.com

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We only collect what Taskify needs to work. Most of it is information you type in yourself.

groups.title: Account details
items: First name, last name and email address when you register
A username (chosen by you, or generated if you skip it)
Your password, which we store only as a bcrypt hash and can never read

groups.title: Optional profile details
items: Date of birth, gender, phone number and a short bio
A profile photo, if you choose one from your camera or photo library

groups.title: Content you create
items: Projects, teams, tasks, due dates and statuses
Comments and the files you attach to tasks
An activity history of changes (for example, who moved a task) and in-app notifications

groups.title: Technical information
items: Sign-in tokens that keep you logged in
Basic server logs (such as request time and errors) used to keep the service running

sections.title: How we use your information
items: To create your account, sign you in and keep your session secure
To send one-time codes (OTP) for email verification and password resets
To show your tasks, projects and teams across your devices
To let teammates see your name, photo and the work you share with them
To send in-app notifications about tasks assigned to you or changes you follow
To fix bugs, prevent abuse and keep Taskify reliable
sections.note: We do not use your information for advertising, and we do not build marketing profiles.

sections.title: Device permissions
paragraphs: The Taskify app asks for a small number of permissions. You can turn each one off in your device settings.

groups.title: Biometrics (Fingerprint / Face ID)
items: Used only to unlock the app if you turn on App Lock
The check happens inside your phone's secure hardware; Taskify only receives a yes or no answer
Your fingerprint or face data is never stored by Taskify or sent to our servers

groups.title: Camera and photos
items: Used only when you pick a profile photo or attach an image
Only the image you select is uploaded; we never browse your library

groups.title: Internet
items: Needed to sync your tasks with the Taskify server

sections.title: What is stored on your device
items: Sign-in tokens, kept in the operating system's secure storage (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android)
A copy of your basic profile so the app opens quickly
Your preferences, such as light or dark theme and whether App Lock is on
sections.note: Signing out clears your sign-in tokens from the device.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. We share it only in these cases:
items: Your team: members of the teams and projects you join can see your name, username, photo and the tasks, comments and files you share there
Workspace admins: Taskify administrators can view user accounts and tasks to manage the service and handle reports
Service providers: our cloud hosting provider runs the Taskify server and database, and an email provider delivers verification and reset codes. They process data only on our behalf
Legal reasons: if we are required to by law, or to protect the safety of users

sections.title: How we keep it safe
items: All communication between the app and our server uses HTTPS
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt before they are saved
Short-lived access tokens with refresh tokens that are revoked when you sign out
Optional biometric App Lock to protect the app on your phone
sections.note: No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information and will notify you if a breach affects your data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your information while your account is active. One-time codes and password reset links expire automatically after a short time.

When you delete your account, it is deactivated immediately, you are signed out on every device, and your profile is no longer visible to others. If you would also like the remaining records permanently erased from our database, email us at taskify2026@gmail.com and we will do so within 30 days.

sections.title: Your rights and choices
items: Access and update your profile at any time from the Profile screen
Change your password from inside the app
Turn App Lock and biometric unlock on or off
Delete your account from Profile settings
Ask us for a copy of your data or for permanent erasure by emailing taskify2026@gmail.com

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Taskify is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has created an account, email us at taskify2026@gmail.com and we will remove it.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as Taskify grows. When we make important changes we will update the date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, let you know in the app.
